//: Everything compiled into @scalar/ruby-fmt's artifact that is not a Cargo crate. collect.py adds the crates linked into rbcop_fmt.wasm from the lockfile. `text` is relative to this directory, `rbcop:` to the rbcop checkout build/rbcop_fmt/build.sh clones, and `canonical:<id>` means the standard text with no copyright line of its own. `license` is the license this package distributes the component under: where a component offers a choice, the one with the lightest notice requirement.

components.name: RuboCop
components.note: rbcop ports RuboCop's cops and compiles in its config/default.yml and config/obsoletion.yml.

components.name: rubocop-performance
components.note: This and the six plugins below: rbcop ports their cops and compiles in their default configuration.

components.name: unicode-display_width
components.note: rbcop's display-width table was generated from it and is compiled in.

components.name: unicode-emoji
components.note: The source of unicode-display_width's emoji data, and so of the same table.
